targets.query:
from(bucket: "market_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "TRADE")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["exchange_name"] == "${exchange_name}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["symbol"] == "${symbol}")
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "price", "size", "side"])

from(bucket: "trade_derived")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "CHART")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["bar_type"] == "CANDLE")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["exchange_name"] == "${exchange_name}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["symbol"] == "${symbol}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["interval"] == "${interval}")
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"])
